attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

mcd11-1.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

mcd11-2.flavorText: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

mcd11-3.flavorText: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

mcd11-4.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

mcd11-5.flavorText: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

mcd11-6.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

mcd11-7.flavorText: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

attacks.name: Sand Tomb
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

mcd11-8.flavorText: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

mcd11-9.flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

attacks.name: Charge Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, attach an Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

mcd11-10.flavorText: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

mcd11-11.flavorText: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

mcd11-12.flavorText: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
